posts.author: AWS ML
posts.text: Accessing OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan. Learn how to run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol, Luna, and Astra on Amazon Bedrock through global cross-Region inference from Singapore, Jakarta, Thailand, Malaysia, and Taipei. This post covers the Converse and OpenAI-compatible APIs, IAM and SCP permissions, quota sizing, and monitoring inference from your source Region.

posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027. Microsoft will make its in-house Azure Maia chips the main AI inference system across its products starting in 2027, deploying them at multi-gigawatt scale. The upcoming Maia 300 should deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. CEO Satya Nadella calls it "our biggest bet yet on our own silicon."
